newsitem.title: UK: Heathrow, Gatwick hit by bomb threats.
newsitem.headline: Heathrow, Gatwick hit by bomb threats.

text.p: Heathrow and Gatwick airports were hit by suspected Irish guerrilla bomb threats on Tuesday in a security alert that also hit huge stretches of nearby motorways.
The motorway link into Gatwick airport was closed after threatening phone calls and both terminals were evacuated, police said.
A spokeswoman for Heathrow said the airport was still open but Terminal Two -- the European flights terminal -- was briefly evacuated. The all-clear was given after some 20 minutes.
